frames.why: Compact dome of earth and matted dry grass with a flaking pale crust, in lawn grass beside a rubber boot. No limb, head, plate or shell margin visible. The pale crust could be called bone only by someone who expects bone.
Domed reddish shell with a painted B15, rim and darker head area at the right, in grass. A living, marked tortoise partly hidden by vegetation.
